messages:
aria: Quick QA note: the Orion-mini-4b model card example uses the old embedding call `client.embed(texts=[...])`. New API is `client.embeddings.create(model=..., input=...)` across SDKs. We should update card examples and add a migration snippet.

ben: Oh dang I missed that. I'll swap out the example. Proposed Python replacement: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="orion-mini-4b", input="example text")
print(resp.data[0].embedding)
```

marta: Also the card's "embedding_size" field is missing; can we add it? It helps folks size storage. For Orion-mini-4b embeddings are 1536.

aria: Add a one-liner under "Notes": "Embedding vector size: 1536 (useful for storage/cost planning)".

doc-bot: checklist: 1) replace embedding snippet in model card; 2) add migration example in SDK migration guide; 3) add embedding_size field; 4) update quickstart if it references old embed call; 5) assign GH reviewers.

yusuf: There's also an external broken link to the nmslib guide in the card. I'll patch to point to the updated nmslib readme. I'll add the fix in the same PR.

ben: I'll open PR, assign @marta for embedding_size + nmslib link fix, @aria for snippet + migration note.

aria: Adding small test snippet to make sure outputs are same shape across SDKs. Also include date stamp.

doc-bot: reminder: ensure code block uses triple backticks and language tags where relevant. Keep bench/sample outputs short.
